topic: Change of Basis in Linear Algebra
target_audience: Undergraduate students in Mathematics, Engineering, or Data Science

sections.title: The Intuition: Points vs. Perspectives
lecture_lines: Points in space are absolute.
A coordinate system provides their numerical address.
Changing the grid changes the coordinates.
The point remains fixed in space.
Perspective defines our numerical description.
animations: Create two separate points, A and B, in #FFFFFF.
Fade in lines connecting A and B to origin in #FF00FF.
Flash A and B to emphasize their positions in #00FFFF.

sections.title: Defining the Basis Matrix
lecture_lines: A basis B defines our coordinate system.
Any vector is a linear combination of B.
The Change of Basis matrix P is a dictionary.
P maps B-basis coordinates to standard ones.
P uses basis vectors as columns.
animations: Draw two basis vectors i and j in #FFFF00.
Show matrix M composed of i and j in #FFFFFF using the reference [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/dictionary.svg].
Animate basis vectors rotating to a new orientation in #00FF00.

sections.title: The Transformation Mechanics
lecture_lines: Coordinates in basis B are [v]B.
The formula [v]std = P[v]B is the bridge.
Matrix P represents the transformation mechanism.
Numerical representations change as the grid shifts.
The underlying vector remains invariant.
animations: Show point P represented as vector in standard basis in #FFFFFF against a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg] background.

sections.title: Inverting the Perspective
lecture_lines: What if we have standard coordinates?
We use the inverse matrix, P inverse.
Basis vectors must be linearly independent.
animations: Display basis matrix M in #FFFFFF using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/matrix.svg].
Show inverse matrix M inverse in #FF0000.
Animate inverse transformation back to original basis in #FFFF00 using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/matrix.svg].

sections.title: Conclusion and Summary
lecture_lines: Change of basis is a change of perspective.
The vector stays fixed in space.
Only our coordinate description changes.
animations: Display summary text: Basis change preserves geometry in #FFFFFF [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/none.svg].
